desc: Ideal for shotguns, handguns, rifles, muzzleloaders, airsoft guns and crossbows. Point-of-impact visibility is enhanced by a fluorescent green halo. Flat finish with fluorescent green or pink background is easy to see downrange. Self-adhesive replacement dots extend target life Shoot target as is or peel-and-stick the target to your favorite backstop. Shot groupings are easy to see downrange. Printed on heavy stock paper with a self-adhesive backing for increased target life.
